notes.title: The Devil's Fiddle Halloween Expansion! (1.10)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8256774/961d937d64367d5fb78adacd0eff4d2f6c28850a.gif[/img]

It's time to raise the safety bar and let the demons and ghosts on board. Mortals pay nothing for this ride... for the devil's fiddle is free!

Changes:
[list]
[*] New Devil's Fiddle mode
[*] Steam controller support
[*] Steam trading cards
[*] Steam leaderboard support
[*] Follow camera
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
